note: Igris downloadable assets, fetched at runtime from EXPO_PUBLIC_ASSET_MANIFEST_URL so a new model never needs an app rebuild. v2 replaced the two loose Piper files with the sherpa-onnx bundle: sherpa needs tokens.txt and espeak-ng-data/ for phonemisation, which Piper's own .onnx.json does not provide. v5 dropped the on-device speech recogniser: the phone records and maestro's /stt transcribes on the Mac, which is both far more accurate and 107MB lighter. v6 added neural Hindi voices (Android's own hi-IN TTS is formant, not neural, and stayed robotic however the text was prepared): 'voice-hi' replaces it for Igris, 'voice-seema' for the companion. Both are optional — missing or not yet downloaded, speech falls back to the phone's built-in Hindi voice, same as before v6. Repoint url at this repo's GitHub Release once assets-v1 is cut (PLAN.md decision #9).
